name: Guru Rabindra Maharana
craftTitle: Master of Palm Leaf Engraving (Tala Pattachitra) & Natural Dyes
bio: Practicing the 800-year-old art using dried palmyra leaves inscribed with an iron stylus (Lekhani) and stained with lamp soot.

name: Smt. Manorama Meher
craftTitle: Bandhakala (Double Ikat) Silk & Natural Madder Root Dyeing
bio: National Award winner leading a 32-women weaving cooperative weaving mathematical poetry and Konark wheels onto handspun silk.

name: Shri Budhuram Bhatra
craftTitle: Ancient 4,000-Year Lost-Wax (Cire Perdue) Dokra Brass Casting
bio: Preserving prehistoric metallurgy methods using beeswax, red river clay, and recycled brass to sculpt indigenous tribal art.
